name: Be A Country
desc:
👍 LIKE and JOIN the group to get +1,000 starting size! 👍

🔴 Welcome to Become A Country! Eat up blobs to become big and eat other countries to become the biggest in the server! Top the leaderboards, earn EPIC skins and more! 🔴

Have fun, and thanks for playing! If you enjoyed, don't forget to 👍 Like, ⭐ Favorite and 🔔 Follow!
